title: Evaluation, Testing & Observability
summary: Know whether a probabilistic system is actually improving: datasets, graders, LLM judges, regression suites, and traces.
outcomes: Build representative eval datasets from real traffic and failures
Choose graders: exact checks, rubrics, and LLM-as-judge, and validate the judge
Run evals as regression gates before every change ships
Instrument traces and metrics that make failures diagnosable
